questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters which when placed in the blank spaces below from left to right will complete the letter series.

G _ N _ Y _ H N R _ _ H N _ Y G _ _ R Y

options.text: H R G Y G R H N
H R N Y G R H N
H R G Y N R H N
H R G Y G R H G

questions.solution:
Checking options one by one:

1) G *__**H**__* N *__**R**__* Y / ***__G__*** H N R *__**Y**__* / *__**G**__* H N ***__R__*** Y / G *__**H N**__* R Y**→ follows a pattern**

2) G *__H__* N *__R__* Y / *__N__* H N R *__Y__* / *__G__* H N *__R__* Y / G *__H N__* R Y→ doesn't follow any pattern

3) G *__H__* N *__R__* Y / *__G__* H N R *__Y__* / *__N__* H N *__R__* Y / G *__H N__* R Y → doesn't follow any pattern

4) G *__H__* N *__R__* Y / *__G__* H N R *__Y__* / *__G__* H N *__R__* Y / G *__H G__* R Y → doesn't follow any pattern

Hence, "*__**H R G Y G R H N**__*" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some H are D.

II. AII D are M.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some M are D.

II. Some H are M.

III. Some D are H.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. Some H are D.

II. AII D are M.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9b218f5f8b7dccc2a646ae36cdb8481365bc3d58f3d0fd370ed209a1713c8c4.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some M are D - **True **(Because, All D are M, it also means Some M are D)

II. Some H are M - **True **(Because, those part of H that is D is also M)

III. Some D are H - **True **(Because, Some H are D, so Some D are H)

So, All conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
In the question below is given a statement, followed by two conclusions numbered (I) and (II). You have to assume everything in the statement to be true, and then decide which of the two given conclusions logically follow(s) beyond reasonable doubt, from the information given in the statement

Statement : The researchers found that excessive internet use draws resources away from mental functions that are essential for completing simple day-to-day tasks.

Conclusion I : One must avoid excessive use of internet

Conclusion II : A clear link exists between levels of engagement with internet and daily lapses in attention
questions.solution:
**Statement:** The researchers found that excessive internet use draws resources away from mental functions that are essential for completing simple day-to-day tasks.

**Conclusion (I):** One must avoid excessive use of the internet. → **follows** (Excessive use of the internet may cause the person to neglect family, relationship, work etc.)

**Conclusion (II):** A clear link exists between levels of engagement with the internet and daily lapses in attention. → **follows** (Spending too much time on the internet can cause you to forget things or face others' cognitive failures)

Here, Both conclusions (I) and (II) are followed.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (4)".**

questions.question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operations(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs except one. Find that odd number pair:
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **First number - 107 = Second number

 
• 444 ∶ 339 → 444 - 107 = 337 ≠ 339
 
• 189 ∶ 82 → 189 - 107 = 82
 
• 401 ∶ 294 → 401 - 107 = 294
 
• 500 ∶ 393 → 500 - 107 = 393

Hence, '**444 ∶ 339**' is the correct answer.
